scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.js && npm --prefix api ci && npm --prefix panel-operacion ci && cd app-cliente && flutter pub get
scripts.backend: node scripts/setup-env.js && docker compose up --build db pasarela-sim api
scripts.backend:dev: node scripts/setup-env.js && docker compose up -d db pasarela-sim && npm --prefix api run migration:run && npm --prefix api run seed && npm --prefix api run start:dev
scripts.test: npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix panel-operacion test && cd app-cliente && flutter test
